behaviors.name: Race
behaviors.intent: Race around the oval in its lane, speeding up and slowing so positions change; lean into the turns.
behaviors.source:
behavior Race
  on tick
    let speed = self.base + sin(time * 0.37 + 0.0) * 0.035
    self.t = self.t + speed * dt
    let lane = self.lane + sin(time * 0.5 + 0) * 0.8
    self.position = (cos(self.t) * (26.0 + lane), 0, sin(self.t) * (14.0 + lane))
    let ahead = (cos(self.t + 0.04) * (26.0 + lane), 0, sin(self.t + 0.04) * (14.0 + lane))
    look self at ahead
    rotate self by (0, 0, 0)
  end
end

behaviors.name: Show
behaviors.intent: Launch fireworks over the stadium every so often.
behaviors.source:
on tick
  every 0.7 seconds
    let p = (random(-24, 24), random(16, 24), random(-30, -12))
    if chance(0.33) then
      spawn("prefab:prefabs/firework_gold.prefab.json", p)
    elif chance(0.5) then
      spawn("prefab:prefabs/firework_pink.prefab.json", p)
    else
      spawn("prefab:prefabs/firework_cyan.prefab.json", p)
    end
  end
end

behaviors.name: Chase
behaviors.intent: Ride just behind and above the leading kart.
behaviors.source:
on tick
  let k = find("Kart Comet")
  let t = k.t - 0.16
  self.position = lerp(self.position, (cos(t) * (26.0 + 4.5), 3.2, sin(t) * (14.0 + 4.5)), 0.12)
  look self at k.position + (0, 0.8, 0)
end
